question: When was the Theosophical Society founded?
solution:
Option **2** is correct, i.e. __**1875**__.

 
• The **Theosophical Society** was **founded** by Madame** H. P. Blavatsky** and Colonel Olcott in **New York in 1875**.
 
• In **1882**, the headquarters of the Society were established in Adyar, near **Madras (now Chennai)** in India.
 
• It is an unsectarian body of seekers after Truth, who endeavour to promote Brotherhood and strive to serve humanity.
